fields.name: coating_type
fields.rationale: The dataset specifies that the steel structures are primed and painted, indicating a specific type of coating applied to the product.

fields.name: manufacturing_standard

fields.name: exc_class
fields.rationale: The dataset specifies that the steel structures are up to EXC 4, indicating the execution class which is a measure of the complexity and risk level of the construction.
